question: A single normal flexible cystoscopy is sufficient to exclude bladder cancer as the cause of painless visible haematuria, and no further follow-up is required.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: Correct — this statement is false. A single normal cystoscopy is not sufficient; recurrent painless haematuria with no established cause warrants repeat investigation and upper-tract imaging.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Actually this is false. One normal cystoscopy does not exclude bladder cancer with certainty; most guidelines recommend follow-up cystoscopy and upper-tract imaging at three months if symptoms recur or no cause is found.
